sql_templates.description: Collect data for FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index for last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.sql_statement:
WITH latest_dates AS (SELECT trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 5), 

fii_dii_data AS (SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend, f.flow_signal 
                 FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f 
                 INNER JOIN latest_dates ld ON f.trade_date = ld.trade_date), 

regime_data AS (SELECT r.trade_date, r.regime, r.confidence 
                FROM signals.regime_history r 
                INNER JOIN latest_dates ld ON r.trade_date = ld.trade_date), 

breadth_data AS (SELECT b.trade_date, b.net_ad, b.ad_signal, b.trin_signal 
                 FROM breadth.market_daily b 
                 INNER JOIN latest_dates ld ON b.trade_date = ld.trade_date), 

index_data AS (SELECT i.trade_date, i.close, i.trend_signal 
               FROM market.index_eod i 
               INNER JOIN latest_dates ld ON i.trade_date = ld.trade_date 
               WHERE i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50')

SELECT fd.trade_date, fd.fii_net_today, fd.dii_net_today, fd.fii_trend, fd.dii_trend, fd.flow_signal, 
       rd.regime, rd.confidence, 
       bd.net_ad, bd.ad_signal, bd.trin_signal, 
       id.close as nifty_close, id.trend_signal 
FROM fii_dii_data fd 
INNER JOIN regime_data rd ON fd.trade_date = rd.trade_date 
INNER JOIN breadth_data bd ON fd.trade_date = bd.trade_date 
INNER JOIN index_data id ON fd.trade_date = id.trade_date 
ORDER BY fd.trade_date DESC;

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on interpreting combined dataset for risk context.']
